title: The narrow escape problem in arbitrary dimension
summary: The narrow escape problem is a prototypical example for studying entropic metastability, motivated by the analysis of biological and chemical systems. The problem concerns the determination of the exit time and position of a Brownian particle trapped in a domain with a reflecting boundary pierced by narrow holes. Our goal is to investigate this problem in a general domain in any dimension (greater than or equal to two), using the quasi-stationary distribution approach to metastability.
